The '''SSP05 hyperdrive generator''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] manufactured by [[Isu-Sim/Legends|Isu-Sim]]. An SSP05 was installed aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], replacing her original [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]]-made [[Avatar-10/Legends|Avatar-10]] hyperdrive. The ''Falcon''{{'s}} SSP05 was substantially and illegally modified by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Klaus Vandangante/Legends|Klaus Vandangante]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. During the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} refit in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the SSPO5 was replaced with a [[Series 401 hyperdrive motivator]].
